angr_version: 9.2.223 (decbench venv; the short-circuit code is unchanged from the 9.2.213 the proposal pinned)
what_shipped: A second, narrower disjunct at the single `is_complex(orblock)` decline inside the short-circuit schema of BOTH structurers (CollapseStructure::rule_block_or, blockaction.rs; RegionStructurer::try_block_or, region_structurer.rs). A *complex* sibling condition block is accepted anyway when it is a BlockCopy of ONE BlockBasic whose printed prefix is bounded, branch-free, and comment-free (kuna_condfold.rs::condfold_eligible). The prefix then renders inside the &&/|| operand as a C comma expression under the printer's existing comma_separate modifier. Port of the angr Phoenix MultiStatementExpression relaxation (_match_acyclic_short_circuit_conditions types a-d, phoenix.py:2688; _should_use_multistmtexprs MAX_ONE_CALL policy; _build_multistatementexpr_statements).

proposal_verdict_corrected.proposal_said: LARGE / new pass type / needs region condition synthesis + C-printer support
proposal_verdict_corrected.actual: increment: kuna already has the BlockCondition node kind, the &&/|| printer, the comma-expression rendering for a multi-statement operand (comma_separate), and TWO independent short-circuit schema implementations. The whole delta was one boolean at the is_complex decline.
proposal_verdict_corrected.angr_algorithm_corrected: angr does NOT hoist the prefix; it wraps the operand in a MultiStatementExpression (a comma expression) in place. No p-code is moved by this PR either.
proposal_verdict_corrected.path_corrected: On build_spec_list the region structurer does NOT converge ([rs] STUCK / ok=false) and ActionBlockStructure re-seeds sblocks and falls through to CollapseStructure -- so blockaction.rs is what emits every character of the measured output. Both paths are patched anyway (they are verbatim copies).

why_wide_exists: kuna's PRINTED statement granularity is finer than angr's AIL for the same source block. On the tr.o third-term candidate, angr renders `find_closing_delim(ptr, v11, *((char *)(v10+cur)), &v7)` as ONE AIL statement; kuna recovers only two arguments and prints the operand computations plus two address-tied copy shadows (`v14 = v1; v14 = v14;`) as separate statements -- 7 printed statements for the same block. `on` is exact angr parity (threshold 5, MAX_ONE_CALL); `wide` raises ONLY the statement cap to 9. The call cap and every soundness/rendering guard are identical at both levels.

bonus_pr53.claim_in_brief: a measured residual of exactly +2 ifs vs angr, from the same root (angr short-circuits `if (!v30 || !strncmp(v30,"en_",3))` twice where kuna emits two nested ifs)
bonus_pr53.reading: ifs 9 -> 7 is exactly the +2 residual PR #53 measured, and both `!v30 || !strncmp(...)` pairs now fold into angr's shape. It costs +1 goto (1 -> 2) from the downstream restructuring, and -4 loc. Strong evidence of generality: this is a different binary, a different function, and the same gate.
bonus_pr53.recon_caveat_resolved: the recon agent could not confirm this statically (its hand count of the strncmp block came to 2 statements). The empirical answer is that the block exceeds the angr-parity cap of 5 printed statements but not the wide cap of 9 -- which is why `on` is a no-op here and `wide` fires.

aggregate_sanity_sweep.method: kuna decompile-all --json at off/on/wide over 5 real binaries; every function whose text CHANGED vs off was syntax-checked by wrapping it in a permissive C translation unit and running `gcc -fsyntax-only` (undeclared-identifier / unknown-type diagnostics filtered out, syntax errors NOT). The checker was validated to reject both failure modes this option could produce: a label inside an expression and an unbalanced condition.
aggregate_sanity_sweep.hard_stop_definition: a function that parses with the option OFF and does not parse with it ON
aggregate_sanity_sweep.reading: Monotone improvement in every aggregate metric in both directions, with no invalid C. The only per-binary inversion is true_ubuntu1804 gotos at wide (59 -> 60), which is the `usage` case above trading +1 goto for -2 ifs and -4 loc.
aggregate_sanity_sweep.note: The sweep was run with the default P8 goto-quality set ON (the real configuration), not with them ablated.

speed.method: The box was under heavy third-party load during measurement (load average 21-35 from another user's Ghidra headless jobs, 80 cores). scripts.pipeline.timeit times all OFF samples and then all ON samples, so load drift over the run does not cancel: successive invocations of the SAME configuration varied from 209 ms to 568 ms median, and the tool reported deltas of +7.9%, +24.1% and +72.0% on three consecutive runs of the same measurement. Those numbers are machine noise, not signal. The honest measurement is INTERLEAVED (alternate off/on/wide per iteration so drift cancels) and on CPU time (user+sys of the child, insensitive to contention).
speed.expected_cost: one extra predicate inside the loop that already calls bb_is_complex (skipped entirely when off), plus one BTreeSet lookup at an existing decline. Structurally sub-1%.
speed.note: The option ships default-OFF for readability reasons, not speed. With it off the precompute is skipped and both gate disjuncts are dead.

gates.make check-spec: OK in lenient AND strict mode

soundness.argument: The fold is rendering-only. BlockGraph::new_block_condition re-parents two existing structuring nodes; no p-code op is moved, reordered, cloned, or deleted. Soundness rests on a precondition rule_block_or already enforces and this option never weakens: orblock.size_in() == 1, so the sibling's statements cannot run on a path where the compound condition is not evaluated. C's short-circuit rule evaluates the right operand exactly when control used to fall into the sibling, and the comma operator is a sequence point, so the prefix still runs before the test.
inherited_preconditions_unchanged: !orblock.is_interior_goto_target()  (NEVER relaxed: emit_block_copy emits the label statement first, so a labelled sibling would print `label_x:` inside an expression)
clauseblock is one of orblock's outs; no self-loop either way
new_guards_all_rendering_or_quality: orblock must be BlockType::Copy of a single BlockBasic (a BlockList/BlockIf/BlockCondition operand could render braces, multiple lines, or a label inside the parens = invalid C)

bounded printed statements (<=5 at on, <=9 at wide) and <=1 call, counted with the printer's own skip rules (not_printed / markers / implied-out / bare CPUI_BRANCH) so the cap governs exactly what appears
no non-terminal branch op (mirrors angr _build_multistatementexpr_statements refusing a non-terminal ConditionalJump or any Jump; a goto is not an expression)
the block must end in a CPUI_CBRANCH
no instruction comment attached in the block (emit_basic_block_ops suppresses emit_comment_group under comma_separate, so folding would silently DELETE a WARNING: line -- decline instead)

a relaxed fold's node is force-marked complex, because BlockCondition::isComplex delegates to sub-block 0 and would otherwise report the LEFT operand's trivial verdict for a node whose right operand is a comma chain, letting rule_block_while_do hoist the whole chain into a while(...) header
soundness.is_complex_blast_radius: is_complex() itself was NOT changed. The relaxation is a disjunct at the two rule_block_or/try_block_or call sites only; the other two callers (rule_block_while_do at blockaction.rs and its region_structurer twin) see the unchanged verdict. This is why the 675-assertion corpus is untouched.
soundness.known_limitation: The comment guard reads Funcdata's buffered analysis comments (pending_comments). A user comment already resident in the console Architecture's comment database is not visible from Funcdata at P8 and would not be seen. Analysis warnings -- the WARNING: lines this option could actually destroy -- are covered.

which_structurer_actually_fires.finding: On every function measured -- build_spec_list (both vehicles), true_ubuntu1804::usage, the synthetic stage witness, and all 13 functions condfold changes in dd and all 7 in basenc -- the region structurer does NOT converge ([rs] structure -> ok=false) and ActionBlockStructure re-seeds sblocks and falls through to CollapseStructure. So blockaction.rs::rule_block_or is the code path the measurements exercise.
which_structurer_actually_fires.verified_preexisting: Confirmed identical on main's prebuilt binary (same [rs] STUCK trace on basenc::rpl_fflush), so this is pre-existing region-structurer behavior on these binaries, not a regression from this PR.
which_structurer_actually_fires.region_structurer_converges_somewhere: Yes -- e.g. basenc::isbase64 and basenc::quote report ok=true. It just does not converge on any function where this fold applies, on the binaries measured.
which_structurer_actually_fires.why_the_mirror_ships_anyway: try_block_or and rule_block_or are verbatim copies of each other; the change is byte-for-byte identical in both. Shipping only one would silently no-op on any function where the OTHER engine converges. The mirror is currently unexercised end-to-end on the measured corpus -- stated here rather than glossed over.
which_structurer_actually_fires.unit_coverage: The gate logic itself (decline when off, fold when eligible, refuse a non-BlockCopy operand, and the force-complex marking that keeps rule_block_while_do from hoisting a comma chain into a while(...) header) is covered by 5 hand-built-graph unit tests in blockaction/tests.rs plus 3 in kuna_condfold.rs.

not_closed: The region structurer still does not converge on build_spec_list ([rs] STUCK: 22 components remain). Making it converge is a separate, larger opportunity; this PR patches both paths but only the CollapseStructure one is exercised on this function.
Default-ON. That needs its own 0/675 ablation and a DIV row; the aggregate sweep above is supporting evidence (monotone improvement, no invalid C), not the ablation.
angr's four schema arms are matched only through Ghidra's ruleBlockOr shape. angr's type_b/type_d (the with-else forms) can fire on graphs ruleBlockOr's topology checks reject; those remain unfolded.
